title.narrative: Health Emergency Preparedness and Response MultiDonor Trust Fund

description.narrative:
"The objective of the Trust Fund is to improve the capacity of governments to prepare for, prevent, respond and mitigate the impact of epidemics on populations.
The countries and territories eligible for support by the Trust Fund are: (i) countries eligible to receive financing from IDA; (ii) member countries not in good standing with IDA; (iii) the West Bank and Gaza; and (iv) Jordan and Lebanon for the benefit of Syrian refugees. It is envisaged that the Trust Fund may, in exceptional cases, support countries eligible for IBRD financing."
